summary: Prices are the 10 Nov closes. The S&P 500 fell 0.4% to 7,520.93, the Nasdaq 0.7% and the Dow 0.3% after October US consumer prices rose 0.4%, above forecasts, lifting the 10-year Treasury yield to about 4.98% and Nvidia down 5.5% on the day. Brent settled at 91.49 dollars, a two-month low, as Washington signalled restraint on Iran, and China extended its rare earth export-control suspension to 10 January 2027. On Wednesday Asia mostly rose on AI chip demand: Taiex +2.1%, Kospi +1.6%, Nikkei +0.8%, with the Hang Seng down 0.7% and Shanghai down 0.3%. TSMC reported October revenue up 59.7% from a year earlier, and COP31 opened in Antalya.

climate.headline: Bolivia declares national emergency over severe drought
climate.detail: Official figures cited at the COP31 opening show more than 75,000 livestock dead and over 114,000 families affected.
climate.source: UN News, citing official Bolivian figures, 9 Nov 2026

climate.headline: KMA: record El Nino to bring a milder, wetter Korean winter, with a possible cold snap in January
climate.detail: October sea surface temperature anomaly in the monitored zone reached 2.6 C and the three-month average topped 2.4 C, both records; this is the strongest El Nino since 1950 records began.

climate.headline: Rhine at Kaub forecast to fall to 5 cm, standard barges cannot pass
climate.detail: Germany's waterways authority forecast the gauge falling through 9 November against a five-year average above 150 cm; diesel barge rates from Rotterdam to Basel are near a record and Ineos cut output in Cologne.

climate.headline: COP31 opens in Antalya amid a climate-finance dispute
climate.detail: Negotiators clashed over developing-country demands to add finance to the agenda; adaptation finance will not get its own item. The EU sees little appetite for new pledges, and no official US government delegation attended.

climate.headline: IMD: below-normal November rain for south India as El Nino curbs the northeast monsoon
climate.detail: Rainfall over the South Peninsula is expected below 77% of the 118.7 mm normal; the second northeast-monsoon storm, Murasu, was forecast to have limited impact on Tamil Nadu.
